participation.context: Said the miles, and let the prepared words go.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: he lets go the words he had made ready for her
relations.quote: I've forgot what I meant to say to her. Good.

story.body: You rode the nine miles to Woodstock in the dark behind a carter's lantern. From the saddle you said that what you meant to say to Anne was gone, and that it was good it was gone.
